name: Sherebiah
bio: Sherebiah, a Levite of understanding, was brought to Ezra at Casiphia along with his sons and brothers, eighteen in all, to serve as a minister for the house of God since no Levites had joined the returning exiles. Ezra entrusted him, along with Hashabiah and ten others, with guarding the temple's silver, gold, and vessels on the journey to Jerusalem (Ezra 8:15-19, 24).
